Despite strong retained earnings (13,060M) and a reasonable EBIT margin (15.3%), the Altman Z-score of approximately 1.37 signals financial distress, primarily due to negative working capital and low return on assets (2.48%). These factors collectively point to a high-risk profile, justifying a speculative grade rating.

DECISION: B+
